title: S14T01 - Decide V2 primary storage writer architecture
description: Current architecture keeps FileBorealStore/state.json as writer, JSONL as bridge, and SQLite as generated cache. V2 needs a committed primary writer path.
acceptanceCriteria: ADR compares event log plus snapshots, SQLite primary writer, and other embedded options with migration and rollback implications.
closedReason: Primary storage writer architecture decision documented and verified.
